meanings.predict: Native prediction window after the cue: no narration; the picture waits. Not silence in the take.
meanings.reading_window: Native reading window after the cue: the voice ends, then the kit's breath, then the authored seconds with the card or panel up and nothing drawn or cleared. Not silence in the take; a proposed pause, not a measured reading time. On a chapter's last cue the closing music breath follows with the card still up.
meanings.kit.music_breath: Native music window after the cue: no narration; the score plays alone. Not silence in the take.
meanings.kit.hold: Native wait for the voice to end plus the kit's breath. Not authored for reading or thinking.
meanings.kit.finish: Calls kit.hold, then closes the chapter.
meanings.wait_until(line.end()): The picture waits for the voice to end. No time is added after it.
meanings.wait_for / wait_sentence / until / sente: Lands a picture on words while the voice runs. Word moments are estimates until takes are aligned.
meanings.pause: A picture beat placed before the cue's voice-end wait in source order. Whether the voice is still running then needs measured takes.
